name: Byredo - Mojave Ghost
history: Launched in 2014, Mojave Ghost is a woody composition inspired by the Mojave Desert. It blends ambrette and Jamaican nesberry with violet, sandalwood, and crisp amber.

name: Le Labo - Santal 33
history: Released in 2011, Santal 33 became an iconic unisex fragrance built around Australian sandalwood and cedarwood, spiced with cardamom, iris, and smoky leather.

name: Parfums de Marly - Delina
history: Created in 2017 by Quentin Bisch, Delina is a modern Turkish rose bouquet brightened with tart rhubarb, lychee, and bergamot over a vanilla and cashmere wood base.

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian - Baccarat Rouge 540
history: Originally crafted in 2014 to celebrate crystal maker Baccarat's 250th anniversary, it pairs airy jasmine and saffron with mineral ambergris and freshly cut cedar.
